resources.string: Connect to custom secure DNS and high-speed WireGuard / Proxy tunnels with one tap. Encrypt your traffic and safeguard your network privacy.\n\n🔒 Privacy promise: We never collect, store, or transmit your network data. All processing happens on your device only.
ZephyrNG uses Android\'s VPN service to establish secure DNS and proxy tunnels. No data leaves your device unauthorized — all routing is managed by your configured servers.
Allow notifications to see real-time connection status and know when your tunnel is active. Required for the persistent VPN notification on Android 13+.
Exclude ZephyrNG from battery optimization so your secure tunnel stays connected in the background and doesn\'t get disconnected by the system.
ZephyrNG is ready. Tap \"Get Started\" to manage your DNS and proxy tunnels.

ZephyrNG is completely privacy-first. We would like your permission to collect anonymous crash reports to help us fix bugs promptly.\n\nThis is strictly OPT-IN, contains NO personal identifiable information (PII), and can be disabled anytime in Settings.
